text:
Unfortunately I'm a little inclined to agree that the recent flood of positive reviews might be botted/scripted... the store beforehand had around 35 (averaging ~3.8/5 stars), and then right before it renovates (not even after it'd opened!), it jumps up to 500 with a 4.9? More reviews than most, if not all, stores in Westfield Parramatta? Common sense suggests it might not be legitimate, but I'd love to be proven wrong.

That aside, I stopped by this Monday to buy something, and when I got to the counter I asked if they had change for a $50 note, and I was told no- they didn't do cash exchanges. I then asked if I had to pay in the exact cash amount, to which I was told that I didn't have to and could pay with my $50? Turns out the cashier thought I meant that I just wanted to exchange my cash, but surely it was obvious that I was trying to buy something, because I was at the counter with items in my hand... despite being the only person at the counter it took a bit of a while for them to scan my item and print a receipt? Usually not a big issue for me, but I just thought it was a little weird seeing everything else that had already happened. Usually service in other branches are much faster, esp. the Chatswood one imo.

Also, the item I bought was covered in a fine layer of black-grey dust on the packaging. It didn't affect the product, just the packaging, but I was wondering if, well, anyone ever cleaned up the products on the shelves? This probably isn't helped by the aisles being very, very narrow- two people can barely pass each other, leading to people stepping over each other and getting trapped in aisles! I will admit that the new layout looks more modern, but seems to have only resulted in a lot of issues movement-wise because they've kind of crammed all their products into a small portion of their store and left other parts completely blank.

For me, I might just stick to the Chatswood W Cosmetics, which I've found is better with its tester availability (and cleanliness), store layout, and staff there are friendlier in my opinion.
